cohort: This case-control study included 1200 peripartum women who received blood transfusions and 2434 who did not, recruited from four large South African hospitals.
finding: Major risk factors for peripartum blood transfusion included antepartum hemorrhage, hemorrhage with vaginal delivery, prenatal anemia, and failed access to prenatal care; while HIV infection and moderately low platelet count were novel risk factors identified.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not independently associated with peripartum blood transfusion.
